decision: Ke hoach 30 ngay treo vao Cong ty, nhieu ban theo thoi gian, nguoi tu dat ngay bat dau
impact: Loai phuong an treo vao Thoa thuan hop tac. Doi lai: khong doc DealStage — enum tu dien ghi la CHUA CHOT NGHIA — nen khong thua ke mon no do vao bang moi. Nhan lai: khong tu dong bat dong ho khi mot thoa thuan chot; nguoi phai tu tao ke hoach

decision: Buoc cua ke hoach duoc CHEP tu khuon, khong tham chieu
impact: Loai phuong an tham chieu templateStepId. Doi lai: sua khuon khong lan sang ke hoach dang chay — nguoi da lam viec theo ban cu. Nhan lai: sua mot loi chinh ta trong khuon khong tu vá cac ke hoach da tao

decision: Bon bac cua ghi danh luu bang MOC THOI GIAN, khong bang Boolean
impact: Loai phuong an co dung/sai. Doi lai: ton mot cot DateTime thay vi Boolean. Nhan lai: tra loi duoc cau cach-bac-truoc-bao-lau, dung thu o Later ve-viec-nao-du-bao-ket-cuc se can; chon Boolean bay gio la tu cat mat duong do

decision: Bo phan la mot BANG NHO quan tri tu them, va no nam tren BUOC chu khong suy tu nguoi duoc giao
impact: Loai enum (them mot bo phan se la migration — dung thu owner noi khong muon ghim cung) va loai chu tu do (loc dem sai ma khong ai thay). Nam tren buoc vi buoc CHUA GIAO cho ai van phai thuoc mot bo phan — do dung la ca viec-roi, ca ma cach suy-tu-nguoi khong bieu dien duoc

decision: Duong noi nen tang di phuong an B: viet schema bien va diem nhan that, kiem that, nhung chua co ben gui
impact: Loai A (chi chuan bi cho, khong co phep do nao chung duoc — loi khai hang-dung) va loai C (noi that trong vong nay — phu thuoc mot doi ngoai vong lap, trai luat vong-mot-phai-dung-xong-doc-lap). Doi lai: schema co the lech voi thu nen tang that su tra; go bang cach dua schema cho doi nen tang doc TRUOC khi code

decision: Activity.assigneeId roi khoi pham vi vong nay
impact: Ban dau may de xuat them cot nay nhu thieu sot chung cua CRM. Doc nep CampaignTouch thay kho giai bai nay bang bang nghiep vu tu mang truong cua no roi noi sang Activity bang khoa duy nhat — nen thiet ke khong can. Doi lai: giao viec cho dong nghiep van chua lam duoc ngoai pham vi onboarding; do la o rieng neu owner thay dang
